summary: The exact approved CPython installer returned exit code 0 but entered Modify maintenance mode for an existing per-user CPython 3.12.10 installation instead of creating the requested isolated Active-only runtime. The target runtime contained no python.exe, so activation failed closed before any wheel sync or candidate import.

attempt.requested_mode: quiet non-admin per-user install with launcher, PATH, associations, shortcuts, documentation, tests, Tcl/Tk, development files, and bundled pip disabled
attempt.unintended_effect: The maintenance transaction removed selected optional components and user integration from the pre-existing same-version installation according to the supplied disabled-feature flags.

failure_evidence.interpretation: Exit code 0 represented a successful maintenance transaction, not successful construction of the approved isolated runtime. Missing target python.exe is the activation gate failure.

recovery.method: The same exact signed installer was run against the detected existing per-user installation with all components observed before the failed transaction re-enabled.
verified_surfaces: pip 25.0.1 imports and python -m pip --version succeeds
test and tkinter packages import; Tk reports 8.6
Include/Python.h, Lib/test, Lib/tkinter, and pip files present
Python launcher and prior user PATH entries restored
registry InstallPath and InstalledFeatures restored to the detected per-user product
recovery.claim_limit: Recovery verifies restoration of the specifically inspected pre-existing installation surfaces. It does not erase the failed maintenance transaction or prove identity for every byte outside those surfaces.

closure_reason: Official installer maintenance semantics do not permit changing the install directory for an already installed same-version product. Repeating this exact candidate would not create the required side-by-side isolated runtime and is prohibited.
next_step: Inventory a materially distinct isolated runtime artifact read-only and obtain a fresh exact owner adoption decision before any download, installation, execution, or synthetic implementation.
